rows.en:
Then Takeuchi started to laugh, eerily.
His twisted face looked like a completely different person's.
"Heh heh heh heh heh...
Hosoda, you really are a gullible fool, aren't you?
It took me two years to find an idiot like you, who'd believe anything anyone told him.
Looks like I'm a good judge of people after all."
"Huh?"
Takeuchi was looking at me with an expression of utter contempt.
I had no idea at all what had just happened.
"What's wrong, Takeuchi?
Please tell me!
What's going on?"
All of a sudden, I felt uneasy.
It seemed Takeuchi had set me up.
"Oh, I'll tell you.
I've finally got a fellow sufferer, so I'm in a good mood.{p}

Since it's come to this, I'll tell you.
Once this thing bites you, you no longer have to go to the restroom.
You think that's a good thing, don't you?
But it isn't.
It's a kind of suffering that only someone who's been through it can understand."
I was confused.
I didn't really understand what Takeuchi was saying.
Not having to go to the restroom seemed like it could only be a good thing.
"What do you mean, Takeuchi?"{p}

"Heh.
Well, you'll find out soon enough, but I'll tell you now.
It's better to be prepared, after all.
Saying I don't have to go to the restroom is misleading. The truth is, I don't go because there's no point in going.
Actually, I do get the urge to go, too.
But I don't go.
Because I know it'd be useless.
Have I made myself clear yet?
What I mean is, no matter how badly I need to go, nothing comes out.
Understand?
Even when I'm absolutely desperate to go, nothing comes out.
It's agony.
Because I have to keep holding it in, forever.
Not that I really need to hold it in, since nothing's going to come out anyway.
But from experience, when you feel the urge, you just can't stay relaxed, can you?
That's why it's torture.
The only way to escape this torment is to rely on this flower.
When this flower sucks it out of me, the urge goes away."{p}

I thought, then why not just carry this flower around with you all the time?
Maybe he sensed what I was thinking, because Takeuchi added this.
"You're thinking I could just keep this flower with me all the time, aren't you?
But that doesn't work.
This flower can only live in the foul air of a restroom.
So I can't carry it around for long.
And unless it gets sunlight, it won't start moving.
Think about it.
The rainy season is hell.
When the sun doesn't come out for days, I have to hold it in the whole time.
I feel like I'm going to pass out.{p}

But now, Hosoda, I can share that suffering with you.
That doesn't mean it'll get any easier for me, but having someone who understands this pain will be an emotional support."{p}

When I heard that, I nearly fainted on the spot.
I mean, you get it, right, {a}{f:|}?
Say, for example, you're on a train and you need to go to the restroom.
But none of the cars has a toilet.
And the next station is hours away.
That's how it's going to be for the rest of my life.
I could never stand it... is what I'd say, but here I am, standing it.
Because I have no choice.{p}

Actually, I figured none of you would believe me, so I've brought that 'flower' here with me.
It's all right.
It won't start moving unless it gets sunlight.
See, this is it, {a}{f:|}.{p}

With that, Hosoda set the flower down in front of {f:me|me}.
It was a truly grotesque flower{f:|}.
After hearing that story, I felt it might start moving any second, and I had no intention of taking a closer look.
Then Hosoda asked me, grinning.{p}
Touch it
Absolutely won't touch it

{f:I|I} decided to take the plunge and touch it.
I slowly reached my hand toward it and..........{p}

"Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
'{f:Waaah|Eeek}!' you went.
No, sorry, sorry.
You've actually got quite a lot of guts.
Normally, no {f:guy|one} would even try to touch it after hearing a story like that."
Hosoda said that with a laugh{f:, but|, but} the next instant, his face turned terrifying, and he said this.{p}

"That's the end of my story, {a}{f:|}.
Please bring on the next person."
Hosoda wrapped up like that, glaring at {f:me|me}.
He was the one who invited me to touch it, so what {f:is|is} with that attitude?
{f:I|I} had no idea at all what Hosoda was thinking.
Not that I particularly wanted to know.
"Well then, next person, please.
Next is..........."{p}

And the strange plant was gone.
When I checked the spot where it had been growing, there were signs that it had been dug up.
Takeuchi must have dug it up and moved it.
Just as I thought, Takeuchi seemed to be hiding something about that plant.{p}

I went around searching for the place he'd replanted it.
Because I wanted to find out more about that plant.
I figured he must have replanted it somewhere that got lots of sun, so I went around searching all the sunny spots.
I found it right away.
You probably know this too, but there aren't any hidden nooks behind the old school building, right?
Besides, it needed a sunny spot, so anything around it casting shade would be bad.{p}

When I went over to look, just as I thought, it seemed to have only just been replanted.
I decided to hide and watch what Takeuchi was up to.{p}

The next day, I ate lunch earlier than usual and was about to hurry over to the old school building.
I got such a surprise.{p}

Because when I dashed out of the classroom, there was Takeuchi, standing in the hallway.
"Oh, uh, Takeuchi!"
The very person I'd been about to secretly spy on was standing right there, so of course I was surprised, right?
Takeuchi came over to me, smiling.
"Hey, Hosoda.
I said some nasty things yesterday.
Afterward, I regretted it, wondering how I could have said something so cruel.
So I came to tell you something good, as a token of apology."
Takeuchi said it quite casually.
It was unexpected. He seemed like a completely different person from the Takeuchi of yesterday.{p}

I decided to accept Takeuchi's kindness at face value.
Takeuchi asked if I'd come with him behind the old school building, and walked there together with me.{p}

When we got behind the old school building, Takeuchi asked me a question, smiling.
"Hosoda, do you know the 'rumor' about me?"
It was the hardest kind of question to answer.
Anyone who goes to this school knows the rumor that Takeuchi never goes to the restroom.
But saying that to his face is a little awkward, right?
I said,
"Uh, well..."
and dodged the question.
"I'll tell you the secret behind that rumor about me never going to the restroom.
It's a very special secret I haven't told anyone.
If you promise not to tell anyone, I'll tell you."
I was stunned.
I mean, he was offering to tell me a secret nobody had ever managed to get out of him.
And only me, at that!
I was so happy, I promised right away.
Takeuchi made me swear to keep the promise, and started talking.{p}

"That rumor about me not going to the restroom... it's true.
But that doesn't mean I'm an alien or anything.
I'm a human being, same as you, Hosoda.
Obviously.
I used to go to the restroom just like everyone else, too.
It was after I started at this school that I stopped going.
So it's only been three years since I stopped going to the restroom.
The secret is in what I eat."
I was amazed.
That just changing your diet could mean you didn't have to go to the restroom.
I'd never heard anything like that.
I love eating too, so I'd read all sorts of books about food and studied it, you know.
But I'd never seen a book that said anything like that.{p}

"You look surprised.
I don't blame you.
Not having to go to the restroom, just from what you eat.
And get this: it works as a diet, too.
Hosoda, I may be skin and bones now, but back in first year, I was about as fat as you.
No, maybe I was a little fatter than you?
But, well, look at me now.
Ever since I changed what I eat.
After that, for some reason, girls started flocking to me, and I stopped having to go to the restroom.
Well? Now you want to know, don't you?"
I nodded and nodded.
When I heard that, I thought, how amazing, I'll eat it no matter how awful it tastes.
"All right, I'll tell you, Hosoda.
That food is actually right here."{p}

With that, Takeuchi pointed at that strange plant.
"Huh? You eat this plant?"
I couldn't believe it.
That this weird plant was something you could eat.
"Yeah, that's right.
This plant was already growing here before I came to this school, and strangely enough, it bears fruit every single day.
You eat that fruit."
Saying that, Takeuchi rustled through the leaves and pulled out a spot where the tip of a stem was swollen.
Then he started peeling the skin off the swollen part.{p}

Inside the swollen part, lots of soft-looking red berries were lined up.
They were a slightly translucent red, about the size of salmon roe.
They were crammed in, with no room to spare.
Do you know sujiko, roe still packed in its sac?
It looked just like that.
Takeuchi bit into it, devouring it greedily.
Squish, squish... I could hear the berries bursting.
The way he ate was really abnormal; he was like a different person from the Takeuchi of a moment ago.
When he'd finished eating, Takeuchi turned to face me.
For a second, my blood ran cold.{p}

Takeuchi's face had changed.
Burst red berries were smeared around his mouth like blood.
"Come on, Hosoda, try some."
A sweet scent, like fresh fruit, drifted toward me.
As if lured by that sweet scent, I tried some.{p}

The feeling of them popping in my mouth was pleasant.
An indescribable flavor, unlike anything I'd ever tasted, spread through my mouth.
Sure, it didn't fill my stomach, but it gave me that feeling of "Ah, now I've eaten."
It's a taste you can never forget once you've had it.{p}

"Well, Hosoda?
Delicious, isn't it?"
Takeuchi asked happily.
"Yes, it's really delicious.
I've never eaten anything this delicious before."
Takeuchi nodded over and over, looking pleased.
"The truth is, Hosoda,
these berries are poisonous.
Poisonous enough that a single one could kill a person."{p}

(Huh...?)
For a moment, I couldn't understand what Takeuchi was saying.
That's right, there was poison in those berries.
I don't know if it was because I'd heard that, but my heart started beating faster.
And then my chest grew painfully tight, as if my heart were being squeezed.
My breathing grew ragged.{p}

"What's the matter, Hosoda?
You look pale.
I was the same at first.
But you'll get used to it soon.
These days, without this, I don't feel like I've eaten at all."
Takeuchi said that, his face pale, swaying unsteadily.
"You don't need to worry, Hosoda.
There's an antidote, of course."{p}

With that, Takeuchi started digging around the roots of the plant.
I couldn't see what he was doing; his back was in the way.
"There it is, there it is."
Takeuchi turned around and held out his right hand to me.{p}

"Hosoda. Eat this.
Then you won't have to die..."
Takeuchi said that as he put something squirming from his left hand into his mouth.
In Takeuchi's right hand...........{p}

Maggots were crawling all over it!
His left hand was swarming with maggots too, wriggling and squirming.
Takeuchi was scooping them up with his tongue and munching them down.
"Come on, if you don't eat them quickly, it'll be too late."
I felt everything before my eyes growing darker and darker.
Did I have to eat maggots?
No, I knew I had to eat them.
If I didn't, I would die.{p}

I grabbed one maggot from Takeuchi's right hand and brought it up to my mouth.
It was crawling along my index finger.
The slightly yellowish-white maggot was right in front of my mouth.
(If I eat this, if I just eat this...)
Even though I thought that, I couldn't bring myself to do it.
But if I didn't eat it, I would die.
I steeled myself and shoved my index finger into my mouth.{p}
When I slowly pulled my index finger out of my mouth, I could feel the maggot crawling around on my tongue.{p}

"Hosoda, you have to chew it well.
Otherwise, it won't work."
Takeuchi said that just as I was about to swallow it whole.
I didn't want to die, so I steeled myself and crushed it between my teeth...
What do you think it tasted like?{p}

Bitter juice spread out with a 'squish.'
It was such a small maggot, but the taste filled my whole mouth.
It was so disgusting that I forced myself to swallow it.
Then the feeling of my heart being squeezed eased off, just a little.
(If I don't eat more, I'll die...)
I grabbed Takeuchi's right hand and licked the maggots straight off it.
This time, a huge mass of maggots came into my mouth.
And around my lips, you know, the maggots that didn't fit were crawling around.
Chewing hard, I put the maggots crawling around my lips into my mouth too, without letting a single one escape, and crushed them between my teeth.
As I ate, the bitter taste gradually started to seem sweet, which was really strange.
..................
Finally freed from the agony, I looked over at Takeuchi.{p}

"Wh-WHAAAAAAH☆"
I let out a scream loud enough to echo through the whole school.
Because there was a corpse buried there.
A schoolgirl's corpse.
Maybe she'd been buried upright, because she was in the ground in a pose like she was looking up.
Out of her gaping mouth, lots of the maggots I'd just eaten were crawling out.
And that strange plant was growing out of the corpse's eye.{p}

"H-hey, don't shout!
Someone'll find us!"
Takeuchi said that calmly.
Give me a break.
Feeling sick, I threw up everything in my stomach.{p}

"Hosoda. Don't tell anyone.
You're one of us now. You've come to know that taste, same as me.
From now on, nothing you eat is going to taste good to you.
And to eat those berries, someone has to be sacrificed.
...Don't worry.
I'll raise this plant until I graduate.
Luckily for me, lots of girls gather around me.
Asking me to tell them the secret of not having to go to the restroom.
So I let them eat those berries.
But the girls can't bring themselves to eat those bugs for the antidote, so they die.
And then I have those girls become nourishment for this plant.
It's not my fault.
I properly teach them how to cure the poison, and they don't eat it and die anyway.
It's the same as suicide..."
Saying that, Takeuchi began filling in the hole again.{p}

Just as Takeuchi said, nothing I eat tastes good to me anymore.
That's why I look forward to it so much: the moment I get to eat those berries.
I don't eat them every day, so it's not like I never have to go to the restroom, though.
For me, not having to go to the restroom isn't all that appealing.
I just want to eat something delicious.
{a}{f:|}, I'll treat you to some of those berries sometime.
They're so delicious, you'll get hooked too.
But you'll have to eat that antidote, okay?
Well, if you can't eat it, I'll just turn you into fertilizer for that plant.
I can't wait.
When should we go eat some?
Well, that's the end of my story.
Who's next?{p}

The next day, I went behind the old school building as usual.
After what happened yesterday, I carefully checked the area so as not to be spotted, but it seemed nobody was there.
Takeuchi might have been hiding, so I looked all around, but he was nowhere to be found.
So I was able to examine the strange plant without worrying.{p}

When I went to the plant, sure enough, it was growing in a spot slightly off from the mark I'd made yesterday.
(I've got time today, so I can investigate as much as I want.)
Thinking that, I decided to start by examining the roots.
Lots of leaves were hanging down over the roots, so I tried to push them aside to look.
Just then.{p}

I felt someone's gaze on me from somewhere.
I hurriedly turned around.
Maybe Takeuchi had come.
He'd told me never to come here again, so I kind of didn't want to run into him.{p}

But there was no one standing there.
Even when I looked around, I couldn't sense anyone nearby.
But I had the feeling that someone was definitely watching me.
Just then, I heard a 'rustle,' like leaves moving.
And there wasn't any wind blowing, mind you.
When I hurriedly looked at the plant, its big leaves were swaying back and forth.
The grass and trees around it weren't moving, but that plant alone was swaying.
It was so creepy, I got chills.
This was the back courtyard of the old school building, after all, so anything could appear at any moment.
The old school building is a gathering place for spirits.
Midday or not, it doesn't make any difference at all.{p}

(Isn't there something about this plant?)
I even started to feel that.
And if so, that only made me more curious about the plant.
I couldn't rest until I'd examined it.
People are like that, aren't they? When there's something scary, sometimes you can't rest until you've checked it out.
For example, say you hear a noise from inside the closet.
There's no reason for anything to make a sound in there.
(What was that noise just now?
Could the doll I put in the closet have started moving?)
Once you start thinking that, you can't rest until you open it and look, right?
Haven't you ever had that happen?
That time too, I was so curious I couldn't stand it.
I pushed the thick leaves aside.{p}

"Wh-whoaaa☆"
My heart nearly stopped.
Because a person's head was sticking out of the ground.
(It's a body!
Someone's body is buried here☆)
That's what I thought at the time.
Its skin was a greenish color, and lines like leaf veins ran beneath it.
I collapsed on the spot, as if my legs had given out.
I was terrified, but I couldn't take my eyes off that head.
As if paralyzed, I stayed face-to-face with the head for a while.
"Eek..."
Then, all of a sudden.{p}

The head's eyes snapped open and glared at me.
Terrified, I scrambled backward, still sitting.
The moment I tried to stand up and run, something grabbed my foot and I fell.
I looked at what was wrapped around my ankle.{p}

The head looked at me and grinned, a long, slow grin.
That was when I realized.
The one buried there was Takeuchi.
"T-Takeuchi☆"
Takeuchi spoke to me in a wheezing voice, like air leaking out from somewhere.
"Hosoda, I told you yesterday, didn't I?
Not to come to this place.
Either you don't understand Japanese, or you've got a terrible memory.
Or are you saying you won't listen to anything I tell you?
...Well, whatever.
I'll make you one of my kind, too.
I'm a generous person, after all.
This body is wonderful.
As long as I'm in the sun, I don't need to eat, and since I don't eat anything, I don't need to go to the restroom, either.
There's nothing more wonderful than this."{p}

Several tentacle-like things came slithering out from around Takeuchi's neck.
They stretched toward my throat.
I tried to swat them away with both hands, but the tentacles coiled around me and I couldn't move.
Then the remaining tentacles reached for my neck and jabbed into it.{p}

"Ow☆"
A sharp pain shot through me, like being stuck with a needle.
But it only hurt for a moment; after that, I didn't feel any more pain.
I felt the tentacles sink deep into my throat and stretch up toward my head.
As the tentacles advanced, I could feel the muscles of my face being pushed up toward the top of my head.
Shhhlurrrp... they crept upward, little by little.
It felt kind of itchy.
A queasy, shivery feeling around my lower back went on for a while.
...I think it was around when they'd reached my brain.{p}

Suddenly, I felt good.
Like soaking in a lukewarm bath in a daze.
It felt like my body was floating, light as air.
In that hazy state, I slowly lost consciousness...{p}

I still can't forget how that felt.
Even now, when I close my eyes and stretch toward the sun, my consciousness slips away and I feel so happy.
After that, Takeuchi and I became really close, and we'd often stretch together in the back courtyard of the old school building.
Even now that Takeuchi's graduated, on sunny days, I stretch toward the sun.
{a}{f:|}.
I'd love to teach you this feeling, too.
It really feels so good.
Let's go behind the old school building together sometime.
I'll teach you the greatest pleasure in this world...
Heh heh heh heh heh...
Well, that's the end of my story, {a}{f:|}.
I'll come by your classroom to get you sometime.
Look forward to it.
..................
...Just now, I thought I saw something like a tentacle stretch out from around Hosoda's neck...........{p}
{f:I|I} thought, {f:there's no way I'm touching that|I am not touching that}, no matter what, and flatly refused.{p}

"My, my, {a}{f:|}.
You're {f:a real coward,|quite a}{f: despite how you look| scaredy-cat}, huh?
{f:Ah|Heh}{f:... no|, heh heh}{f:, sorry|, oh}{f:, you're exactly what you look like|, that's hilarious}.
Ah ha ha ha ha!"
What {f:is|is} with this guy?!
Upperclassman or not, there's a limit to how much he can make fun of people!
{f:I|Ugh,}{f: felt like punching him right then and there, but| I want to go home already, but}{f: when I thought of| when I think of} the newspaper club's future{f:, I gritted my teeth and held back.|, I can't do that.}
{f:But|Still}{f: I got worked up, too,|, this is so unpleasant...}{f: and the words just slipped out.| Ugh!}
"Fine.
I just have to touch it, right?★"
{f:I|Fed up,}{f:| I} touched the petals in one quick motion.
In that instant☆{p}

"Ow!"
Incredibly, the flower started moving and {f:bit my hand|bit down on my hand}.
"{f:Whoa|Eek}, {f:whoa|no}!"
No matter how hard I shook my hand, it wouldn't let go.
Maybe it was sucking my blood. The sluggish feeling spreading through my body felt good.{p}

"This is amazing, {a}{f:|}!
The flower moved without any sunlight.
This is a new discovery!
Maybe it'll be able to suck it out of me even on rainy days☆"
Hosoda was getting excited all by himself, not caring in the least that {f:I'd|I'd} been bitten.
When I heard that, even {f:I|I} finally lost my temper.
{f:I|I} grabbed the flowerpot of the flower biting my hand and {f:brought it down on Hosoda|swung it around wildly}.{p}

Everyone who'd gathered began to murmur and stir.
(What have I done{f:|}?
{f:Losing my temper and hitting him like that|Hitting him like that, even if I didn't mean to}...)
{f:I|I} finally realized what I'd done, and nearly panicked.
The club room door opened, and someone ran out.
They must have gone for help{f:.|, I'm sure.}{p}

Hosoda was lying there, blood streaming from his head, twitching.
({f:I'm|I'm} definitely not getting off easy for this{f:|}.
With that much blood, Hosoda {f:won't make it|might not make it}.
What's going to happen now{f:|}...?
...More importantly, what am I supposed to do if I need to go to the restroom{f:|}...?
If what Hosoda said is true, then now that this flower has withered, {f:I|I}'ll have to hold it in for the rest of my life{f:|}.
What do I do{f:|}...){p}

I couldn't believe I was thinking such things with Hosoda right in front of me, his lips turned purple, not moving a muscle.
(Maybe getting bitten by that flower turns you into an irresponsible person{f:|}.
Maybe that's why Hosoda could only talk the way he did.
Well, who cares{f:|} about {f:a guy|someone} who's already dead.
Maybe Hosoda's happy.
After all, he doesn't have to hold it in anymore.
Even though {f:I|I}'ll have to hold it in for the rest of my life.
Somehow, it's making me really angry{f:|}.)
{f:I|I} {f:kicked the motionless Hosoda in the side of the head with all my strength|looked down at the motionless Hosoda's face}.
In the distance, I could hear police sirens.{p}
